### Main questions

We want to find the mutation statistics for Ben's samples

### 1.0 Package requirements

- Include required packages 

```{r include = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

require("stringr")
require("BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38")
require("rtracklayer")

```

- change to current working directory `/export2/home/koustav/Projects/012-Ben-Clarke-ERAP1-KD/analysis/`.


- Set paths

```{r}

setwd("/export2/home/koustav/Projects/012-Ben-Clarke-ERAP1-KD/analysis/")
analysis_path <- "18-screening-for-erap2-mutations-in-postmortem"
save_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "rdata_files")
plot_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "plots")
input_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "input_files")
output_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "output_files")

dir.create(save_dir)
dir.create(plot_dir)
dir.create(input_dir)
dir.create(output_dir)

```

### 2.0 Include experiment matrix

- Import the list of SNPs and filter for those that are within the ERAP2 gene body

```{r include = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

mutation_df <- data.table::fread(file.path(input_dir, "GCST90027164_buildGRCh37.tsv"), data.table = F)

mutation_ranges <- GRanges(seqnames = mutation_df$chromosome, 
    IRanges(start = mutation_df$base_pair_location, end = mutation_df$base_pair_location),
    name = mutation_df$rsid, ref = mutation_df$effect_allele, alt = mutation_df$other_allele)

chain_object <- import.chain("18-screening-for-erap2-mutations-in-postmortem/input_files/GRCh37_to_GRCh38.chain")

converted_mutation_ranges <- liftOver(mutation_ranges, chain_object)
converted_mutation_ranges <- unlist(converted_mutation_ranges)

seqlevelsStyle(converted_mutation_ranges) <- "UCSC"

hg38 <- BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38
all_sequences <- getSeq(hg38, converted_mutation_ranges)

# matches with reference, nothing to be done
ref_matches_reference <- all_sequences == converted_mutation_ranges$ref
alt_matches_reference <- all_sequences == converted_mutation_ranges$alt

switch_ref <- converted_mutation_ranges$ref[alt_matches_reference]
converted_mutation_ranges$ref[alt_matches_reference] <- converted_mutation_ranges$alt[alt_matches_reference]
converted_mutation_ranges$alt[alt_matches_reference] <- switch_ref

converted_mutation_ranges <- converted_mutation_ranges[ref_matches_reference | alt_matches_reference]
converted_mutation_ranges$ref <- toupper(converted_mutation_ranges$ref)
converted_mutation_ranges$alt <- toupper(converted_mutation_ranges$alt)

```

- Fetch all alt alleles

```{r}

    all_mutation_df <- data.frame(
        chromosome = seqnames(converted_mutation_ranges),
        pos = start(converted_mutation_ranges),
        reference = converted_mutation_ranges$ref,
        alternative = converted_mutation_ranges$alt)

    write.table(x = all_mutation_df, 
        file = file.path(input_dir, "01-van-rheenen-gwas-mutations-summary-statistics.txt"),
        sep = "\t",
        quote = F,
        col.names = F,
        row.names = F)

```
